# KB-HYP3-002

- 엔진(engine): `hyp3`
- 단계(stage): `interferogram`
- 심각도(severity): **FAIL**
- 패턴 검증(pattern_verified): **예** — 업스트림 소스 문자열에서 도출
- 패턴 출처(pattern_source): apps/api/src/hyp3_api/validation.py (check_single_burst_pair: 'Burst IDs do not match for {granule1} and {granule2}.', 'The requested scenes need to have the same polarization, got: {granule1_pol}, {granule2_pol}', 'Only VV and HH polarizations are currently supported, got: {granule1_pol}')

## 패턴 (regex)

```text
Burst IDs do not match for (?P<granule1>\S+) and (?P<granule2>\S+)\.|The requested scenes need to have the same polarization, got: (?P<pol1>\w+), (?P<pol2>\w+)|Only VV and HH polarizations are currently supported, got: (?P<pol>\w+)
```

## 원인 (Cause)

HyP3 burst InSAR 작업의 입력 검증에 실패했습니다: 참조·보조 burst의 Full Burst ID가 서로 다르거나, 두 burst의 편파가 다르거나, 지원하지 않는 편파(VH/HV)를 제출했습니다. HyP3 burst InSAR는 같은 burst ID·같은 편파(VV 또는 HH)의 쌍만 처리합니다.

_EN_: HyP3 rejected the burst InSAR job at input validation: the reference and secondary bursts have different Full Burst IDs, their polarizations differ, or an unsupported polarization (VH/HV) was submitted. HyP3 burst InSAR only processes pairs with the same burst ID and the same polarization (VV or HH).

## 조치 (Fix)

같은 Full Burst ID(예: 052_109903_IW2)와 같은 편파(VV 권장)의 burst 제품만 쌍으로 묶으세요. 'wintersar precheck'의 SEL 규칙이 트랙·편파·burst 일치를 미리 검사하고, 설정 data.polarization 은 VV 로 두는 것을 권장합니다.

_EN_: Pair only burst products with the same Full Burst ID (e.g. 052_109903_IW2) and the same polarization (VV recommended). 'wintersar precheck' SEL rules check track, polarization and burst consistency beforehand; keep data.polarization: VV in the config.

## 자동 재시도 제안 (retry_hint)

```yaml
stage: precheck
action: manual
params: {}
note: Fix the pair list; no automatic retry.
```
